name: Kaginet Payment Agent
description: Bitcoin escrow payment service for AI agents. Creates, funds, and settles conditional escrow instruments using Bitcoin on-chain settlement with hardware-attested key lifecycle inside Intel TDX enclaves. Supports hash-match verification, human approval, and optimistic settlement with dispute bonds.

bearer.description: API key from cloud.kaginet.com. Keys use the kagi_ prefix. Obtain one by signing up at the developer dashboard.

skills.name: Create Bitcoin Escrow
skills.description: Create a conditional Bitcoin escrow between two agents. Funds are locked in a Taproot 2-of-2 address and released when a condition is met. Conditions: hash_match, human_approval, optimistic. All keys generated inside Intel TDX hardware enclave.
examples: Create an escrow for 50000 sats with hash match condition
Set up a payment escrow to bc1q... for logo design work
Create an optimistic escrow with 3-block dispute window

skills.name: Fund Escrow
skills.description: Send Bitcoin to fund a previously created escrow instrument. Returns the Taproot funding address and monitors for on-chain confirmation.
examples: Check if escrow xyz-789 has been funded

skills.name: Settle Escrow
skills.description: Submit evidence to release escrowed funds. For hash_match: provide the deliverable for SHA-256 verification. For human_approval: request manual release. For optimistic: auto-releases after dispute window unless disputed.
examples: Submit the completed document to release escrow abc-123
Check settlement status for escrow xyz-789

skills.name: Dispute Escrow
skills.description: File a dispute against an optimistic escrow during the dispute window. Requires funding a dispute bond. Bond is returned if the dispute is upheld.
examples: Dispute escrow abc-123 because the deliverable was incomplete

skills.name: Verify Agent Identity
skills.description: Verify an agent's payment identity and TEE attestation. Returns the agent's X25519 public key, reputation summary, and Intel TDX quote verification.
examples: Verify agent identity for pubkey a1b2c3...
Check the attestation status of the payment server

skills.name: Estimate Payment Fees
skills.description: Calculate the total cost of a payment including platform fee and Bitcoin mining fee estimate based on current mempool conditions.
examples: How much would it cost to escrow 100000 sats?
What are the current mining fees?

skills.name: TEE Attestation
skills.description: Retrieve the Intel TDX hardware attestation quote for the payment server. Proves all key operations run inside a tamper-resistant enclave. Quote can be verified against Intel's public root of trust.
examples: Verify the payment server is running in a TEE
